rule.description: A unit of behavior — a class method (including constructors, getters, setters, and class-field functions) or a module-level function — performs at least 4 reactive-state operations (.get/.set/.value calls or .rawValue reads) on one and the same foreign reactive data object, i.e. a receiver chain rooted outside the unit's own `this` state. A module-level function that receives the data object directly as a (possibly destructured) parameter is exempt as the codebase's established module-glue idiom; reaching through a parameter's member to the data object remains envious. The threshold is calibrated at 4 because no unit of behavior in the pinned clean repository concentrates 4 or more such operations on a single foreign receiver.

checks.description: Detect class methods whose reactive-state operation volume concentrates on one foreign reactive data object (the foldable model reached through a controller/view field), i.e. behavior that interprets the foldable's keys implemented far from the class that owns the data.
checks.detected_relation: consumer class method -> foreign reactive data owner (Foldable model: completed/expanded/expandedHeight/shouldFixHeight/temporaryExpanded)
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The method is more interested in the foldable model's data than in the state of its own class: it reads and writes the foldable's keys, derives foldable-level rules (height, class application, completion bookkeeping), and keeps none of that knowledge with the data owner. The behavior belongs to the object whose data it primarily accesses.

matches.evidence: Derives the folder container height from the foldable's temporaryExpanded, expanded, expandedHeight, and shouldFixHeight keys and writes it to the container element.
Runs the whole expansion choreography on the foldable: falsifies completed, clears expandedHeight, toggles temporaryExpanded around a reflow-measure pass, then fixes shouldFixHeight.
Same beforechange choreography on the foldable for the inline color picker: completed falsification, expandedHeight/temporaryExpanded toggling, shouldFixHeight fixing.
View method interpreting five foldable keys at once: applies expanded/completed classes to the wrapper element and derives the gated inline picker height from expandedHeight/shouldFixHeight.
Derives the inline pad picker height from temporaryExpanded, expanded, expandedHeight, and shouldFixHeight and applies it to the picker element.
Third copy of the beforechange measurement choreography on the foldable, guarding the nullable inline picker element.

excluded: Module-level functions that receive the data object directly as a (possibly destructured) parameter, e.g. upstream-style binding and value-synchronization helpers such as bindFoldable(config: primary/secondary) or connectValues({primary, secondary}); they are the established module-glue idiom of this codebase, so only reaching through a parameter's member to the data object is treated as envied.

Units of behavior whose receiver-root operation volume stays below 4 on every foreign root: the clean repository's genuine handlers (keepSelection_, onButtonClick_, onPadButtonClick_, button-click handlers around the pickers) hold at up to 3 operations; the injected supporting methods (finishExpansionTransition_, finishPickerTransition_, finishPopupTransition_, syncExpansionClasses_) also stay below the calibration threshold and are not credited as locations of the smell.
